text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "Dear Teacher,"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘It feels like it's been a while since I 
wrote a letter. Excluding New Year's 
cards, I wonder how long it's been since I 
actually gave someone a letter.’"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that I wouldn't be able to put it 
into words well if I spoke to you face to 
face this time. So, I took up my pen 
instead. Please forgive me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Also, please forgive me if there are any 
mistakes in my words. It has been a long 
time since I graduated from your classes, 
so there are some things I have 
forgotten."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: “Now then, moving on to the main topic.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "I want you to live."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I made a bet with you. That I would make 
you harbor hope for the future."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"However, as you know, even after summer 
passed... even as autumn deepens, I do not 
believe the evaluations of me have reached 
our goal."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I know even without asking. Someone like 
me isn't fit to be anyone's hope just 
yet."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"However, please give me just one more 
chance."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, an Umamusume appeared 
before me... saying that because of me, 
she 'found hope to live.'"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: "I realized I didn't want to lose to her."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Believing that clinging to hope means 
never giving up, reeling in a miracle even 
by a spider's frail, slender thread."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to hold onto hope through my 
actions. I want a miracle to happen."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Please watch the Chunichi Shimbun Hai. 
I'm counting on you. Sincerely, Nakayama 
Festa"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Dad, can you get the paper for me?

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Dear Nakayama Festa,"

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your letter. Since it is 
still difficult for me to speak aloud, I 
will follow your lead and reply by letter 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"After the Kikuka-sho, when you came to my 
hospital room. There was something I 
wanted to tell you directly."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"In an era where a quick email or text 
would suffice, I still wanted to tell you 
face-to-face. I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"So for the next time they visit my 
hospital room, I decided to have a letter 
ready as well."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "I am your—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So you came to the Chunichi Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. What about you? Is your hoof 
completely healed?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's why I'm gonna win! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You were dragging your feet all summer, 
and now you're acting like a weight's been 
lifted.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Classic Triple Crown races so far 
were all GⅠs, but this one is a GⅢ.
choice_data_list:
If it's Nakayama Festa, I'll take first 
place!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Count on it.
